t: This Milwaukee 50mm Hex Shank PZ2 Screwdriver Bit is engineered for heavy-duty impact driving, providing a robust fastening solution for trade professionals. Featuring laser-hardened WEARGUARDTIP technology, it offers improved wear resistance and a precise fit throughout its lifespan. The optimised SHOCKZONE geometry flexes to absorb impacts, reducing stress and minimising breakages, making it ideal for demanding tasks on construction sites or in busy workshops. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, this PZ2 bit delivers increased resistance to the shock of high-torque applications.
b: Suitable for Power Screwdrivers with Impact Mode
